description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans reminders table implementation using PostgreSQL as the storage backend. It defines a test class with setup methods and several test cases for reminders table operations.

classes.name: PostgreSqlRemindersTableTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying PostgreSQL-based reminders table operations in Orleans, inheriting from ReminderTableTestsBase.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logger filter options for the test class.

methods.name: CreateRemindersTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of AdoNetReminderTable configured for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Returns the invariant name string for PostgreSQL ADO.NET provider.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up a relational storage instance and retrieves its connection string.

methods.name: RemindersTable_PostgreSql_Init
methods.description: Test method for initializing the reminders table (empty implementation).

methods.name: RemindersTable_PostgreSql_RemindersRange
methods.description: Test method for verifying reminders range functionality with 50 iterations.

methods.name: RemindersTable_PostgreSql_RemindersParallelUpsert
methods.description: Test method for verifying parallel upsert operations on the reminders table.

methods.name: RemindersTable_PostgreSql_ReminderSimple
methods.description: Test method for verifying simple reminder operations.
